how: Play Store kholo → search me 'Google Business Profile' likho → Install dabao
App kholo → 'Add your business to Google' dabao → dukaan ka naam likho
Apna poora address aur mobile number likh kar Next dabao
task: Play Store se 'Google Business Profile' app download karo aur apni dukaan ka naam, poora address aur phone number likh kar naya business profile banao.
title: Google Profile Banana Shuru Karo
why: Log ab Google par 'qareeb dukaan' likh kar dhoondhte hain — profile hoga to aap sab ko nazar aayenge.

how: Google Business Profile app kholo → 'Photos' par tap karo → 'Add photos' se 5 tasveeren chun lo
'Edit hours' par tap karo → har din ka khulne aur band hone ka time set karo
'Save' dabao — ye sab Google par foran nazar aane lagega
task: Apne profile me dukaan ke andar-bahar ki 5 saaf tasveeren aur roz ke khulne-band hone ka time likho.
title: Dukaan ki Photos aur Timing Lagaao
why: Achhi photos dekh kar gahak bharosa karte hain aur sahi time dekh kar ghalat waqt par nahi aate.

how: App me 'Edit profile' → 'Business information' → 'Category' se apna kaam chuno
'Description' me 2-3 lines likho: kya bechte ho, kitne saal se, kya khas hai
'Get verified' dabao → Google jo tareeqa de (video ya code) wo poora karo
task: Apne business ki sahi category chuno, ek chhoti si wazahat likho ke kya bechte ho, phir 'Verify' ka button dabao.
title: Category, Wazahat aur Verification Mango
why: Sahi category ka matlab hai sahi gahak aap tak pahunchenge, aur verified dukaan logon ko asli lagti hai.

how: Play Store kholo → 'WhatsApp Business' search karo → Install karo
App kholo → apna dukaan wala number likho → aane wala code likh kar verify karo
Apne business ka naam likho → category me apna kaam chuno
task: Play Store se 'WhatsApp Business' app download karo aur apne dukaan wale number se account banao.
title: WhatsApp Business App Install Karo
why: Ye app dukaan ke liye bani hai — isme aap catalog, auto-jawab aur qeemat-list laga sakte ho.

how: WhatsApp Business kholo → upar 3 dots → Settings → apne naam par tap karo
'Business profile' kholo → photo lagao → address, timing aur description likho
Neeche 'Save' dabao — profile ab har naye gahak ko poori lagegi
task: Logo wali profile photo, poora address, roz ki timing aur dukaan ki chhoti wazahat — sab kuch bharo.
title: WhatsApp Business Profile Poora Karo
why: Jab naya gahak aapka number khole to use poori maloomat mil jaye — poochna na pare, foran bharosa bane.

how: WhatsApp Business me 3 dots → Settings → 'Business tools' → 'Catalog' → 'Add new item'
'+ Add images' se product ki photo chuno → 'Price' me qeemat likho
'Item name' aur 'Description' me ek line likho → 'Save' dabao
task: Apne 3 sab se mashhoor products ki saaf tasveer kheecho aur qeemat plus ek line ki wazahat ke saath catalog me daalo.
title: Catalog Shuru Karo: Pehle 3 Products
why: Gahak ko ab aap se poochna nahi parega 'qeemat kya hai' — wo khud dekh kar foran order karega.

how: Catalog kholo → neeche '+' ya 'Add new item' dabao
Product ki saaf photo lo → qeemat likhna na bhoolo
Wazahat me size, colour ya quantity bhi likh do → 'Save'
task: Aaj 3 aur products ya services add karo — din ki roshni me tasveer lo taake saaf aaye.
title: Catalog me 3 Aur Products Daalo
why: Catalog jitna bara, gahak utna zyada dekhega aur utna zyada kharidega — choti dukaan online bari lagti hai.

how: Catalog me baqi 3-4 items add karo (wahi tareeqa jo pehle seekha)
Har item khol kar qeemat dobara check karo — ghalat qeemat bharose ko khatam karti hai
Ek dost ko apna catalog bhej kar poocho: sab samajh aa raha hai?
task: Baqi mashhoor products add karo aur purane items ki qeemat check kar ke sahi karo.
title: Catalog Mukammal Karo: Aakhri 3-4
why: Mukammal catalog ka matlab hai dukaan 24 ghante khuli — gahak raat ko bhi dekh kar subah order karega.

how: WhatsApp Business me 3 dots → Settings → 'Business tools' → 'Quick replies' → '+' dabao
'Shortcut' me chhota naam likho (misal: timing) → neeche poora jawab likho → Save
Kisi chat me '/' likh kar dekho — aapke save kiye jawab foran aa jayenge
task: Wo 3 sawalat jo roz poochhe jate hain (qeemat? timing? location?) unke jawab 'quick reply' me save karo.
title: Quick Replies Bana Kar Time Bachao
why: Ek hi jawab bar bar likhne ka waqt bachega aur har gahak ko foran jawab milega.

how: Business tools → 'Greeting message' ON karo → apna salam, dukaan ka naam aur timing likho → Save
Wapas ja kar 'Away message' ON karo → apni band hone ki timing select karo
Paigham me likho: 'Assalam-o-Alaikum! Dukaan band hai, subah jawab dunga InshaAllah'
task: Naye gahak ko khud-bakhud 'salam' wala paigham aur raat ko band hone par auto-jawab set karo.
title: Greeting aur Away Message Lagao
why: Raat ko message karne wala gahak subah tak intezar nahi karta — auto-jawab usay rok kar rakhta hai.

how: Facebook app kholo → upar 3 lines (menu) → 'Pages' → 'Create' → 'Business' chuno
Dukaan ka naam likho → apni category chuno → 'Create' dabao
Agar page pehle se hai to usay kholo → 'Edit Page' se naam aur photo theek karo
task: Facebook app me apni dukaan ka page banao, ya agar purana page hai to uska naam aur photo theek karo.
title: Facebook Page Banao Ya Theek Karo
why: Facebook par aapke sheher ke hazaron log hain — page aapki dukaan ka online board hai.

how: Page kholo → upar camera icon (cover photo) → 'Upload photo' se dukaan ki best tasveer lagao
'About' → 'Edit' → 'Contact info' me apna WhatsApp number likho
About me ek line bhi likho: kya bechte ho aur timing kya hai
task: Page par dukaan ki khubsurat tasveer (cover) lagao aur 'About' me apna WhatsApp number likho.
title: Cover Photo aur About Me Number
why: Achhi tasveer dekhne wala rukta hai, aur number dekhne wala foran rabta karta hai.

how: Page kholo → profile ke neeche '+ Add button' ya 'Edit button' dabao
List me se 'WhatsApp' chuno → apna number likh kar confirm karo
Apna page khud khol kar button dabao — WhatsApp khulna chahiye
task: Page ke upar wala button 'WhatsApp' par set karo taake gahak ek tap me aap se baat kare.
title: Page Par WhatsApp Button Lagao
why: Har extra step gahak ko khota hai — ek button dabane se seedha WhatsApp khule to order foran hota hai.

how: Chrome kholo → 'sites.google.com' likho → apne Google account se login karo
'+ Blank' dabao → upar apni dukaan ka naam bara likho
Pehli line likho: 'Assalam-o-Alaikum! Hamari dukaan me khush aamdeed' — Publish abhi mat dabao
task: Chrome me 'Google Sites' khol kar ek bilkul simple ek-safhe wala page banao — ye aapka 'link in bio' hoga.
title: Free Link Page Banana Shuru Karo
why: Aapke WhatsApp, catalog, Facebook, location — sab ka link ek jagah hoga, gahak kahin bhatkega nahi.

how: Apni Google Site kholo → neeche '+' (Insert) → 'Button' dabao
Button ka naam 'WhatsApp par Order Karen' rakho → link me apna WhatsApp link lagao (ye link aapko template me milega)
Aise hi 'Dukaan ka Pata' button banao → Google Maps se apni location ka link lagao → 'Publish' dabao
task: Page par apne WhatsApp ka link, dukaan ki location aur catalog ka link bade buttons ki tarah lagao.
title: Link Page me WhatsApp Location Daalo
why: Gahak ko jo chahiye wo ek tap me mile — jitna asaan, utne zyada orders.

how: Site ka link copy karo (Publish ke baad milne wala address)
Facebook page → 'Edit Page' → 'About' me website ki jagah ye link lagao
Instagram profile → 'Edit profile' → 'Links' me yehi link lagao → WhatsApp Business profile me bhi website ki jagah yehi
task: Jo link page banaya hai uska link apne Facebook page, Instagram bio aur WhatsApp Business profile me daal do.
title: Bio me Apna Link Laga Do
why: Har jagah ek hi link ka matlab hai gahak chahe kahin se aaye, manzil ek hi — aapki dukaan.

how: WhatsApp kholo → purani chats dekho → wo 5 naam kagaz par likh lo jo khush thay
Google Business Profile app me 'Ask for reviews' dabao → apna review link copy kar lo
Aaj sirf list tayyar karo — paigham kal bhejna hai
task: Apne phone ya WhatsApp se wo 5 purane gahak chuno jo aap se khush hain — kal inhi ko review ki request bhejni hai.
title: Pehle 5 Khush Gahak Chuno
why: Khush gahak ka ek review naye gahak ke liye aapki sab se bari sifarish hai — muft ka ishtehar.

how: Ye paigham copy karo: 'Assalam-o-Alaikum! Hamari dukaan se kharidari ka shukriya. Agar waqt ho to Google par chhota sa review de dein — is link par tap karen:'
Har gahak ko uske naam ke saath ye paigham aur review link WhatsApp par bhejo
Aaj 5 bhejo — kal 5 aur, zyada ek saath mat bhejo
task: Un 5 gahakon ko WhatsApp par pyar bhara paigham aur review link bhejo — neeche template diya gaya hai.
title: 5 Gahakon ko Review Request Bhejo
why: Log review dena bhool jate hain — ek naram yaad-dihani se aapke pehle reviews aa jayenge.

how: Baqi 5 gahakon ko wahi review wala paigham aur link bhejo
Google Business Profile app me 'Reviews' kholo → har review ke neeche 'Reply' dabao
Jawab likho: 'Bohat shukriya! Phir tashreef laiyega' — har review ka jawab do
task: Baqi 5 gahakon ko request bhejo aur jo reviews aa gaye hain un sab ka shukriya ada karo.
title: Baqi 5 Reviews aur Jawab Do
why: Review ka jawab dene se naye dekhne wale samajhte hain ke dukandaar gahak ki qadar karta hai.

how: Din ki roshni me product ki saaf tasveer lo (pehle camera saaf kar lena)
Facebook page kholo → 'Create post' → tasveer lagao aur ek line likho: 'Fresh stock aa gaya! WhatsApp par order karen'
Wahi tasveer Instagram par post karo aur WhatsApp me Status par bhi lagao
task: Dukaan ya apne best product ki ek achhi tasveer lo aur Facebook page, Instagram aur WhatsApp status — teeno par lagao.
title: Pehli Post: Dukaan ki Tasveer
why: Roz nazar aane wali dukaan logon ke zehen me rehti hai — bhooli hui dukaan se koi nahi kharidta.

how: Ek product chuno → us par aaj ke liye chhoti chhoot ka faisla karo
Tasveer lo → caption likho: 'Aaj ki khas offer: is product par 10% chhoot! Sirf aaj — WhatsApp karen'
Facebook, Instagram aur WhatsApp status — teeno par lagao
task: Ek chhoti si offer banao (misal: aaj 10% chhoot) aur usay tasveer ke saath teeno jagah post karo.
title: Chhoti Offer Wali Post Lagao
why: Offer dekh kar log foran faisla karte hain — 'kal le lenge' wala gahak 'aaj' kharidta hai.

how: Kisi khush gahak se poocho: 'tasveer laga dun?' → ijazat mile to tasveer lo
Post likho: 'Hamare pyare gahak ka shukriya! Aap bhi tashreef laein'
Teeno jagah lagao — ijazat na mile to apne kaam ki tasveer laga do
task: Kisi khush gahak ki (ijazat se) ya apne kaam ki tasveer lagao aur shukriya wali post karo.
title: Gahak ki Tasveer Ya Shukriya Post
why: Asli gahak ki tasveer sab se mazboot bharosa hai — log sochte hain 'ye dukaan to chalti hai'.

how: Facebook page par apni sab se achhi post kholo → neeche 'Boost post' dabao
'Goal' me 'Get more WhatsApp messages' chuno
Aaj sirf setting dekhni hai — paise lagane ka button kal dabana
task: Facebook par 'Boost post' ka button dhoondo aur apni sab se achhi post ko ad ke liye chuno — abhi paise mat lagao.
title: Rs500 Ka Pehla Ad Tayyar Karo
why: Chhota ad aapke sheher ke un logon tak pahunchta hai jo aapko nahi jante — naye gahak ka sab se sasta rasta.

how: Boost post me 'Audience' → 'People in your area' chuno → apna sheher likho
'Budget' me Rs 500 likho → 'Duration' 3 din set karo
Neeche WhatsApp button confirm karo — ad se message seedha aapke WhatsApp par aaye
task: Ad ki setting me apna sheher aur qareeb ka ilaqa chuno, budget Rs 500 aur muddat 3 din set karo.
title: Sirf Apne Sheher Ka Ad Lagao
why: Door ke sheher ka aadmi aapki dukaan nahi aayega — paise sirf un par lagao jo aa sakte hain.

how: Sab setting check kar ke 'Boost post now' dabao → payment ka tareeqa chuno
Har ghante WhatsApp check karo — naye messages ka 5 minute me jawab do
3 din baad dekho: kitne messages aaye? Rs 500 me kitne gahak mile?
task: Ad ka 'Boost' button dabao, payment karo aur aane wale har message ka foran jawab do.
title: Ad Chalao aur Messages Dekho
why: Ad ka paisa tabhi wasool hota hai jab har message ka jawab foran mile — der karne wala gahak doosri dukaan chala jata hai.

how: Play Store se 'Canva' install karo → Google se free account banao
Search me 'price list' likho → apne kaam se milta-julta design chuno
Design kholo — kal isme apni qeematen likhni hain
task: Play Store se 'Canva' app install karo aur 'price list' wala tayyar design chuno — ye muft hai.
title: Canva App Install aur Design Chuno
why: Khubsurat qeemat-list dekh kar gahak ko lagta hai ye dukaan professional hai — achhi tasveer bara asar karti hai.

how: Canva me design kholo → purana text dabao → apne product ka naam aur qeemat likho
Neeche apna WhatsApp number aur dukaan ka naam bhi likh do
'Share' → 'Download' dabao → ye tasveer WhatsApp status par lagao aur gahakon ko bhejo
task: Chune hue design me apne products ke naam aur qeematen likho, apna WhatsApp number lagao aur save karo.
title: Apni Qeemat-List Tasveer Banao
why: Ek hi tasveer me sab qeematen — gahak bar bar 'qeemat kya hai' nahi poochega, seedha order karega.

how: Phone ki Settings → 'Notifications' → WhatsApp ki awaz ON aur tez karo
Dukaan me ek chhota board lagao: 'WhatsApp par foran jawab!'
Aaj har message ka time dekho — 5 minute se zyada der na lage
task: Aaj se har WhatsApp enquiry ka jawab 5 minute ke andar do — phone ki notification awaz tez kar do.
title: 5-Minute Jawab Ka Usool Lagao
why: Tez jawab dene wali dukaan se log kharidte hain — aksar gahak usi se kharidta hai jo pehle jawab de.

how: Phone ki call history roz 3 dafa check karo: subah, dopahar, shaam
Missed number par foran call karo → na uthaye to WhatsApp karo: 'Assalam-o-Alaikum! Aapki call miss ho gayi, kaise madad kar sakta hun?'
Phone me alarm lagao: har 3 ghante baad missed calls check karna
task: Jo call miss ho jaye usay 10 minute me wapas karo aur ek chhota WhatsApp paigham bhi bhej do.
title: Missed Call Foran Wapas Karo
why: Missed call wala gahak aapka intezar nahi karta — foran call back usay kehti hai 'aap hamare liye ahem hain'.

how: Google kholo → apni dukaan ka naam likho → dekho: profile, photos aur reviews sab nazar aa rahe hain?
Reviews gino aur kagaz par likho: 'Day 30 — reviews: itne, catalog items: itne'
Neeche agle 30 din ke 3 kaam likho: roz post, hafte me 2 review request, mahine me ek Rs 500 ad
task: Google par apne business ka naam search karo, reviews gino, aur agle 30 din ka chhota plan kagaz par likho.
title: Apna Hisab Karo Agla Plan Likho
why: Jo naapa jata hai wo barhta hai — aaj ka hisaab batayega ke agle mahine kya dobara karna hai.
